Cc: payments@clearset.com

Subject: ClearSet bank letter + remittance format

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Attached is our bank letter for vendor setup and the PDF copy of a recent invoice to illustrate how we typically present remittance info. We are ready to accept ACH; our bank will push two micro-deposits to verify the account. The deposits are small amounts (USD) and typically post within 48 hours of setup.

For your records I've included:
- clearset_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 67KB) — bank letter with account/routing details (redacted on copy)
- clearset_sample-invoice.pdf (PDF, 98KB) — shows our preferred remittance text line: "ClearSet Payments — INV 1002 / PO: [your PO here]"

Could you confirm how Redwood expects the remittance/reference string to be encoded on the payment? A few customers put PO then invoice; others want a single combined reference. We can format whichever way makes reconciliation easiest. Also let me know if you need a W-9 or any additional onboarding evidence.

Thanks,
Rachel Wong
Head of Finance Operations
ClearSet Payments

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearSet bank letter + remittance format

Hi Rachel — thanks for sending these over and the sample invoice. A couple quick asks so Finance can complete vendor setup in NetSuite: 

1) Legal Entity Name and TIN (W-9). If you can attach a completed W-9 (or equivalent for non‑US entities) we can finish tax classification.
2) Confirm the exact micro-deposit amounts (you mentioned they’re small) or the expected posting window so Finance knows when to check.
3) For remittance text, Redwood prefers the format: "PO:[PO_NUMBER] INV:[INVOICE_NUMBER]" in the ACH remittance/reference field. Example: "PO:RDW-2027-889 INV:1002". If ClearSet can place the PO number first followed by the invoice, reconciliation will be automatic.

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form for any missing fields — legal address, remit-to postal, contact, payment terms. If you can fill and return, we'll kick the vendor record creation.

Next steps: once we have the W-9 + bank letter confirmed and the micro-deposits post, Jonas will verify the account and we’ll schedule the first payment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding & Procurement
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rdw_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf]
